description: This file defines the `CanvasWindowController` class, a key component managing a window containing a WebKit view in a macOS application. It handles initialization, configuration of the WebView, scheme handling, loading URLs and files, snapshot creation, and interaction with a custom file watcher. The class also manages UI aspects such as window presentation, debug status, and communication bridges between JavaScript and native code.

classes.name: CanvasWindowController
classes.description: A window controller managing a WebKit view for rendering and interacting with canvas content, including URL loading, JavaScript evaluation, snapshot creation, and communication between native and web contexts.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of CanvasWindowController, configuring the WebView, scheme handlers, JavaScript bridges, and file watcher.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Performs cleanup by removing script message handlers and stopping the file watcher.

methods.name: applyPreferredPlacement
methods.description: Sets the preferred placement of the window.

methods.name: showCanvas
methods.description: Displays the canvas window, optionally loading a specific path.

methods.name: hideCanvas
methods.description: Hides the canvas window and persists frame if it's a panel presentation.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a URL or file path into the WebView, handling different schemes and paths.

methods.name: updateDebugStatus
methods.description: Updates the debug status display on the WebView.

methods.name: applyDebugStatusIfNeeded
methods.description: Applies the current debug status to the WebView via JavaScript.

methods.name: loadFile
methods.description: Loads a local file URL into the WebView with proper access permissions.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript code within the WebView and returns the result as a string.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Creates a PNG snapshot of the current WebView content and saves it to a specified path.

methods.name: directoryPath
methods.description: Returns the file system path of the session directory.

methods.name: shouldAutoNavigateToA2UI
methods.description: Determines whether to automatically navigate to the A2UI based on current and last target paths.
